snippet.title: Twenty Six - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Twenty Six! (Coming 2025)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3638060/Twenty_Six/

Twenty Six is an action-packed bullet hell that you play through the multiverse- and experience how it was made in parallel dimensions!

Each dimension changes how the player and how the blocks work. However, these can be mixed, resulting in 676 different verses!

Your goal is simple: Start from AA and get to ZZ!
